items.text: The account has no statement of trust; this scope is proposed here, on its model of waiting. Restoring needs a formation sparing all it waits on, which gives from step 1 whatever the start; without one, total withholding stays. And mutual promises alone cannot start a loop with no source, which limits 'begin with contact'. Verification has a limit of its own: behaviour at an unread occasion can differ while every reading agrees, where no read occasion shares its lump; intention and another's false belief are not stated. Tolerance is not shown good. [AI reading]

**Reading** [AI reading, D48]. Cooperation among strangers is giving that waits on giving across chains longer than any acquaintance; that more waiting gives no more is the structural price of complexity. "Others will deceive me, so I deceive first" is withholding with memory, which absorbs. Kept promises and enforced contracts are laws giving first: the law changes, not the state alone. Tolerance lets cooperation survive scattered withholding, not rebuild it where it is lost everywhere; mutual promises alone cannot start  a loop with no source ([a grounded start](#grounded-start)). An exchange of harms is a loop: answering in kind keeps the difference, answering more runs away, so conflict institutions are links of another kind ([bounded conflict](#kept-together)); a regulator lags wherever the world changes faster than it reads.
